To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of non-standard techniques in the process of learning a foreign language is an effective way to facilitate the acquisition and development of language skills.
the level of development and manifestation of language abilities, as well as their potential, are significantly influenced by the level of motivation to learn a foreign language.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is the role of personality oriented dialogues in the process of teaching a foreign language?

the following issues: what is the relationship between the motivation of mastering a foreign languages and the level of the development of abilities to learn foreign languages, what are the main factors influencing this relationship, what are the conditions that allow us to weaken this influence, and what are the main directions for the development of the psychological theory of learning foreign languages.
the study of the influence of the personality oriented dialogical method of teaching a foreign language on the level of development and functioning of abilities for foreign languages.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of non traditional techniques for teaching foreign languages in the conditions of a personality centred dialogical approach significantly improves the quality of the process of teaching foreign languages.
in the conditions that provide the opportunity to realise the individual potential of students, the development of potential abilities for languages does not play a significant role.
the personality oriented dialogical approach in teaching a foreign language, in addition to other positive effects, also has a positive effect on the motivation of learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the psychological research of the ability to foreign language acquisition is the ability to use a foreign language in the process of communication, which is formed as a result of the development of the language abilities of a person.

in the conditions when a student has a high level of development of language abilities, the motivation to learn a language is not a factor that determines the level of development, while in the conditions when the development of language abilities is low, motivation is the main factor in the level of development.
the psychological research of the ability to foreign languages acquisition is an important and urgent problem for modern psychology.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the psychological research of the abilities to learn foreign languages should be based on the concept of the development of abilities for foreign languages, which is the basis for the development of the theory and practice of foreign language teaching.
it is possible to create an effective system of learning foreign languages that will take into account both the individual features of the student and the specifics of the language material.

the psychological research on the ability to acquire foreign languages has become an integral part of the scientific paradigm of the psychology of mastering foreign language, which has been developing since the beginning of the 21st century.
